issues.problem: time value 夕方 gives unnatural English 'until the evening yesterday' and an odd pairing with 寝ました
issues.action: replaced 夕方 with 一時 'one'

issues.problem: 会社{に/へ}着きます: へ with 着く is not as natural as に, so it should not be accepted as an equal alternative
手紙を書きました: へ (先生へ手紙を書く) is also natural but was not listed, and listing it would only fit some values
issues.action: replaced with お礼を言いました 'thanked'

issues.problem: メールを送りました: へ is also natural for 送る but was not listed
issues.action: replaced with 電話しました 'phoned'
